notes.title: Many Issues
notes.content:
We are having many issues. We had a ex Developer (who barely contributed to the game) start removing all kinds of stuff.

The ex developer has fiddled with the steamworks options for this game, meaning builds and all other stuff need to be restored.

This means the game is unplayable at the moment, please give us some time to fix this issue we are having.

I am THE ONLY Developer for this game right now and basically always was, so don't trust anyone else as a developer except me. Though the ex dev HAS been kicked and removed from all things possible, there still might be attempts to attack the game.

Thank you for your patience and we apologize for the inconvenience that the ex developer has caused.

Join our steam group for updates: http://steamcommunity.com/groups/GreyRealityStudios
